title: Imperial trade: fleets, the Manila galleon and contraband
goal: Read how trade between Spain, America and Asia was organised and how contraband worked, and use formal phrases of means such as a través de and por medio de.

items: Use *a través de*, *por medio de* and *mediante* to say by what means things happened.
Say through which port trade passed for a long time.
Say between which two places the Manila galleon sailed.
Explain what contraband was and how goods reached the colonies in secret.
Use the key words of trade: fleet, port, galleon, pirate and silk.
I can use *a través de*, *por medio de* and *mediante* to say by what means things happened.
I can say through which port trade passed for a long time.
I can say between which two places the Manila galleon sailed.
I can explain what contraband was and how goods reached the colonies in secret.
I can use the key words of trade: fleet, port, galleon, pirate and silk.
